name: Bernkastel-Kues (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bernkastel-Kues (quartered with keys, a bear and a crayfish).
history: Municipal flag of Bernkastel-Kues; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bernkastel-Kues arms — keys, bear and crayfish
